google-ads-management.lede: In 2026, Google’s smart bidding does the heavy lifting, but the algorithm is only as good as the data you give it. Garbage in, garbage out. If your conversion tracking is broken, your bidding optimizes toward the wrong actions and your budget is wasted on signals that don’t correlate with revenue. The same applies to structure: too many campaigns and overlapping keywords create internal competition. Complexity is the enemy of performance. MadMarketing fixes both: right structure, right tracking, from day one.

google-ads-management.lede: MadMarketing’s Google Ads service is built around the three variables that actually determine campaign performance in 2026.

items.title: Clean conversion data. Not just "conversions tracked."
items.text: Smart bidding (tCPA or tROAS) is only as good as the conversion data you feed it. Most accounts track page views or form opens, and the algorithm optimizes toward those, not actual purchases or qualified leads. We set up conversion tracking to measure what actually drives revenue. This single change routinely produces the biggest ROAS improvements of anything we do.

items.title: The 2026 Power Pack, not seven campaigns fighting each other.
items.text: Google’s recommended structure for 2026 is the "Power Pack": Performance Max for broad reach, AI Max for Search for high-intent queries, and Demand Gen for consideration-stage audiences. Most accounts have none of this, they have 5–10 disconnected campaigns with overlapping keywords. We build the right architecture from the start, or rebuild it if you’re coming from a mess.

items.title: Ad copy written by someone who knows what Google is actually testing.
items.text: Google’s search ads automatically test combinations of your headlines and descriptions, but only the ones you give it. Most businesses provide generic, similar headlines that give the algorithm nothing interesting to test. We write up to 15 distinct headlines per campaign, then use Google’s performance reports to refresh what isn’t working every month.

Paid ads stop the moment your budget does. SEO does the opposite, every ranking page keeps bringing in customers month after month. But it only works when three things move together: genuinely useful content targeted at buyer-intent keywords, authority from real backlinks, and the on-page and technical structure that lets Google rank you at all. Most providers do one and ignore the rest.

MadMarketing handles all three. Real writers research and produce long-form, keyword-targeted blog posts. We place white-hat backlinks on real DA 20–65 publications, never private blog networks or link farms. And Managed SEO ties strategy, content, on-page, technical fixes, and links into a single program with a dedicated strategist and transparent monthly reporting. You see every link, every ranking, and exactly what we’re working on next.
